_🎯 Functional Correctness_ | _🟠 Major_ | _🏗️ Heavy lift_

**Do not reuse the control slot until the old transfer is quiescent.**

The supplied `src/portable/chipidea/ci_fs/hcd_ci_fs.c` implementation makes `hcd_edpt_abort_xfer()` a no-op. This handler ignores that result and releases the global control slot. If the device later completes the old transfer after a callback starts another transfer to the same `daddr`, the guard in `usbh_control_xfer_cb()` accepts the old event as part of the new transfer. Require effective cancellation before reuse, or identify completions by transfer so a late event cannot advance the new transfer.

Review comment at @src/host/usbh.c around lines 2292 - 2298:
Update the timeout path around hcd_edpt_abort_xfer() so it does not call
control_xfer_complete() and release the control slot unless cancellation is
effective; alternatively, associate completions with a transfer identity and
have usbh_control_xfer_cb() reject events from an earlier transfer before they
can advance a reused slot.
